mathematical_contract.selection_rule: component topology is selected by the authored strict predicate branch > 0; a positive-dimensional factor on which branch is identically zero contributes no overlap or isolated pair
mathematical_contract.division_rule: Hypersolve 66ad4fc exposes exact bivariate polynomial division over canonical Real coefficients; Hypercurve accepts only exact division or an exact component report with a strict stored-bidegree decrease
mathematical_contract.partial_factor_rule: for H=F*G with branch divisible by F, only F is removed from topology support; G is replayed against the original branch polynomial rather than a canceled or inferred sign
mathematical_contract.residual_rule: topology-only support reduction never replaces the two residual equations produced by division of the authored intersection system, so isolated residual contacts remain candidates
mathematical_contract.isolated_zero_rule: an isolated branch zero is not a positive-dimensional factor and is not canceled; it remains an explicit boundary classification pending exact selected-set partition support
mathematical_contract.gate_rule: an exact nondegenerate projection can skip common-factor extraction; an APPROXIMATE_512-capped or otherwise uncertain projection always falls through to the exact extractor and therefore cannot reduce capability
mathematical_contract.rational_map_rule: equation replay and finite-domain partition precede an empty selection decision; branch roots are then isolated once and reused across every retained monotone domain
mathematical_contract.policy_rule: APPROXIMATE_512 may terminate only inherited equality, ordering, and sign predicates at 512 bits; it never manufactures a factor, quotient, root, or branch sign
mathematical_contract.termination: every repeated factor-removal step strictly lowers stored bidegree; full-component divisibility terminates immediately and all fallback work is cold

new_path_evidence.rational_component: a rational shared component whose selected branch restricts identically to zero publishes empty component evidence while its exact divided residual system continues
new_path_evidence.implicit_complete: a product of two disjoint implicit ovals selected by the complete product is removed as one unselected positive-dimensional set
new_path_evidence.implicit_partial: when only the lower oval factor is branch-zero, exact extraction removes that factor and transports all four cells of the surviving upper oval
new_path_evidence.projection_gate: shared support is classified positive-dimensional while a branch line with only two isolated oval crossings is classified nondegenerate under both policies
new_path_evidence.optimized_release_tests: the two zero-branch fixtures pass together in 0.05 seconds and the projection-gate fixture in 0.00 seconds in the warmed all-feature release profile
new_path_evidence.historical_outcome: the parent stack cannot remove a selected zero-branch component or quotient a partially unselected implicit support, so no completed-work throughput ratio is claimed

benchmark_method.ordering: fresh same-checkout-path processes interleaved in rotating historical, initial, and final order

hardware_counters.method: three fresh pinned complete benchmark-group processes per revision under perf stat; event coverage was 100 percent

performance_interpretation.initial_observation: cross-root wall comparisons falsely suggested a larger regression; rebuilding and running immutable binaries from one checkout path removed that code-layout confound
performance_interpretation.followup: ordinary implicit certification now returns before any new algebra; whole-component division, multiplicity reduction, relation gating, and selected-factor extraction are cold and not inlined; rational branch roots are isolated once per map
performance_interpretation.final_observation: the complete-process median is 0.60 percent faster than the initial implementation and 0.15 percent faster than the parent; six of ten established component medians improve versus the initial implementation, while all movements versus the parent remain between -0.01 and +1.66 percent with identical checksums
performance_interpretation.counter_boundary: the final binary retires 0.21 percent more instructions but 0.21 percent fewer cycles than the initial implementation; measured wall throughput, not instruction count alone, is the performance gate
performance_interpretation.claim_boundary: the historical stack exits before completing the new zero-selected topology, so existing completed lanes are guards rather than a speed ratio for the new mathematical path

memory.rss_method: the same five interleaved fresh pinned benchmark processes measured with /usr/bin/time
memory.heaptrack_method: one direct, unpinned complete benchmark-group process per historical and final revision; timing under instrumentation is not used
memory.interpretation: the final complete process removes eleven allocation calls, adds no temporary allocation, and adds no rounded peak heap; no persistent per-object state was added

release_size.interpretation: the feature adds 0.14 percent text versus the parent; the cold followup adds no text and removes 340 loadable bytes versus the initial implementation
